valid.name: async-function-bodies
valid.source:
(defmacro identity (value) value)
(defasync load (value) (await (identity value)))
(defconst loader (async (value) (await (identity value))))

valid.name: exception-clause-bodies
valid.source:
(defmacro identity (value) value)
(defun recover (value)
  (try (identity value)
    (catch error (identity error))
    (finally (identity nil))))

valid.name: vector-binding-patterns
valid.source:
(defmacro identity (value) value)
(defun unpack ([first second])
  (let (([left right] (identity [first second])))
    [left right]))
(defun recover ()
  (try (throw [1 2])
    (catch [code value] (identity [code value]))))

valid.name: optional-rest-and-list-operations
valid.source:
(defmacro build-call (operator &optional first &rest rest)
  (cons operator (append (list first) rest)))
(defun total () (build-call + 1 2 3))
(defun empty () (build-call list))
(export total empty)

valid.name: automatic-generated-names-are-unique-across-calls
valid.source:
(defmacro once (form)
  `(let ((value$ ,form)) value$))
(defun first-value () (once 1))
(defun second-value () (once 2))
(export first-value second-value)

valid.name: quoted-markers-and-deliberate-capture
valid.source:
(defmacro capture-target (value) `(setq target ,value))
(defun update (target) (capture-target (+ target 1)))
(defconst marker 'value$)
(export update marker)

valid.name: conditional-macro
valid.source:
(defmacro choose (test yes no) (if (null test) no yes))
(defconst answer (choose nil 1 2))
(export answer)

valid.name: nullish-predicate-macros
valid.source:
(defmacro classify-nullish (value)
  (cond
    ((nil? value) '(quote nil-only))
    ((undefined? value) '(quote undefined-only))
    ((nullish? value) '(quote nullish))
    (t '(quote other))))
(defmacro legacy-nullish (value)
  (if (null value) '(quote nullish) '(quote other)))
(defconst nil-kind (classify-nullish nil))
(defconst undefined-kind (classify-nullish undefined))
(defconst false-kind (classify-nullish false))
(defconst legacy-kind (legacy-nullish undefined))
(export nil-kind undefined-kind false-kind legacy-kind)

valid.name: macro-evaluator-core
valid.source:
(defmacro calculate (value)
  (let ((current value))
    (setq current (+ current 2))
    (cond
      ((and (> current 3) (equal current 4)) (list 'quote current))
      (t current))))
(defmacro condition-value (value) (cond (value)))
(defconst answer (calculate 2))
(defconst direct (condition-value 5))
(export answer direct)

valid.name: portable-truthiness-and-numbers
valid.source:
(defmacro falsey? (value) (not value))
(defmacro computed-values ()
  (list 'quote
    (list (/ 1 2)
          (length "😀")
          (concat "flag-" t "-" false "-" undefined))))
(defconst false-result (falsey? false))
(defconst undefined-result (falsey? undefined))
(defconst zero-result (falsey? 0))
(defconst computed (computed-values))
(export false-result undefined-result zero-result computed)

valid.name: component-and-expression-boundaries
valid.source:
(defmacro identity (value) value)
(defcomponent View (props)
  (let ((value (identity props)))
    (js-object :fixed (identity value) literal-key (identity value) (identity :computed) (identity value))))
(export View)
